# Offline analysis fixtures

Generated by `python3 scripts/generate-analysis-fixtures.py` using ffmpeg.
`signal.wav` contains 1.3 seconds of deterministic 48 kHz stereo PCM with regional
amplitude changes. FLAC, VBR MP3, AAC, and Opus are encoded from that same PCM.
`no-xing.mp3` is CBR without a Xing duration header, exercising the duration-hint
path. All audio is synthetic. No third-party recordings are included.

Opus fixtures also cover low-bitrate mono input at 16 kHz (decoded at 48 kHz), 5.1
audio, 120 ms packets, three milliseconds of audio, digital silence, and a -6 dB header output gain with
separate R128 tags. Host tests construct chained, damaged, and offset-wrapped
variants in temporary files rather than storing additional audio copies.

Android tests additionally generate float WAVs to cover multichannel audio,
192 kHz PCM, silence, and very short tracks, and wrap fixtures in descriptors
with nonzero start offsets and limited lengths.
